x: Ted Stimpson showed a welcome return to form, and Arthur Penny also showed there is life in the old 'uns. M.

The best running was that of two of our under twenty-ones, Eddie Short and Mike Heard who finished fourth and twelfth respectively. Harry Churcher is back on the Road again and so far unbeaten this year, although pulled out of the “ Belgrave Open.” Perhaps it is because we think he wins quite enough anyway!

Eddie Short was our first man home in fourth position, and was well supported by Mike Heard 12th, Ron Minahan 19th, and Eric Herbert 27th. We fielded four teams and all closed in, our other placings being: F.
Mike Heard was unlucky in being a sufferer from that bugbear of all cross-country runners known as "stitch," and also went off the course near the end of the race and so did not finish.
In the Junior (under 21) event there were 20 teams and we did well to finish in 6th place. Eddie Short led our team home in 6th position, Mike Heard was 12th, Eric Bishop 27, and Len Bishop 68.

In the Junior race Eddie Short was again our first man home in 7th position, and to gain such a high place in a race speaks well for Eddie's strength and determination. Mike Heard also ran well in finishing 40th and Arthur Bruce ran pluckily on a damaged foot to be 56th, with Eric Bishop 65, R.

With the help of Dick Towndrow, and such as Archie Bedford, Eddie Short, Mike Heard, “Ginger” Kennedy and Jack Brown, to mention only a few of our promising members plus the help of last season's stalwarts, I think we shall have yet another successful year over the country.
Eddie Short was rather unlucky in just missing a place, he finished 4th in last year's race, and Mike Heard and Arthur Bruce both did well in such a large field.

Tom Carter is still showing useful form for an old 'un, and it is to the younger element such as Mike Heard, Len Adams, Bragginton, Popplewell and Ches Walker, that we look to for support in the more serious races to come.
Mike Heard also ran well in finishing 40th and Arthur Bruce ran pluckily on a damaged foot to be 56th, with Eric Bishop 65, R.Garwood 112, L.C.Bishop 117, and L.A.Adams 138.
